name: Seiyuu Danshi ~ After Stories ~
source:
After stories is a compilation of extra Seiyuu Danshi episodes that deviate from / out of scope of the game's original setting. Additional episodes will be released in a monthly basis, and are exclusive for patrons. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/meyaoigames]Patreon[/url]]

Popularity polling result announcement:
The result for the 1st character popularity poll of Seiyuu Danshi is out! How would the characters react to their popularity ranking? Are they satisfied with it or not? And more importantly... Who is the most popular character in Seiyuu Danshi?

Doppelganger?!:
Somehow, one thing leads to another and our protagonist finds himself with his doppelganger. Of course, what better thing to do with your doppelganger then to try to have sex with him?
